newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's franchise sales rise 26 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's franchise sales rise 26 pct in 1996.

text.p: Sales at Mexico's 370 retail franchises will rise about 26 percent in 1996 compared to 1995, Mexican Franchise Association director Jose Luis de Prado said Wednesday.
The director told Reuters, "$3.8 billion is being sold to the final public consumer." Last year's sales were $3 billion, he said.

According to a preliminary survey by the association, foreign and national franschise chains registered a total of 895 openings and reported just 38 closures to make a total of 30,395 franchise outlets in the country.
Of all franchises, 60 percent are Mexican and the remainder foreign-based, de Prado said.
Investment in Mexico's franchise system in 1996 totalled $250 million, compared to $280 million in 1995, he said.
